text:
Jordan (Support): Heads-up: OrbitalHealth trial can't ingest — embeddings endpoint returning 403/"quota_inactive" since 11:02 AM PT. They were mid-import and onboarding is scheduled this week. Escalating to CS. :bangbang:

Maya (CSM): Thanks Jordan. Can you paste the minimal repro + account id so I can prep a message?

Jordan (Support): Account: orbital-331
Repro: ```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_orb_***' \
  -d '{"input":["a","b"]}'
HTTP/1.1 403
{"error":"quota_inactive","detail":"no_active_quota"}
```

Priya (CS Ops): Looking in admin: orbital-331 -> plan=trial-lite, active_quota=0, billing.status=payment_needed. Likely provisioning didn't finalize.

Luis (AE): This is a time-sensitive pilot. Champion already told me they’ll decide on purchase if pilot completes this week. If they stall, conversion risk increases.

Maya (CSM): Quick triage playbook: 1) temporary unblock (CS Ops) 2) short customer update + apology (CS) 3) capture product feedback in PM board (CS) 4) billing recovery flow (Billing). Owners: Priya, Jordan, Maya, Luis.

Priya (CS Ops): Requesting emergency quota enable now. Marking as "temp-unblock-orbital-331". ETA 12m.

BillingBot: Billing note created for orbital-331 at 1806601320: last_payment=card_failed. Recovery email queued to finance@orbitalhealth.com.

Jordan (Support): Also noticed their integration sent huge batch payloads (batch_count=400) which burned initial quota immediately. Might be helpful to recommend default batch limits in onboarding docs.

Maya (CSM): Draft note to customer (will send after unblock): "Hi <Name> — we've identified a provisioning issue that prevented embeddings and applied a short-term fix so your ingest can continue. Can we grab 20m today to review and collect feedback? We're also opening an internal ticket to prevent recurrence." Thoughts?

Luis (AE): Fine. I'll include a short slide on upgrade options and reserved capacity benefits.

Priya (CS Ops): Temp quota activated at 1806601390: +30k vectors/day for 48h. Audit logged.

Jordan (Support): Re-tested with customer — ingest now succeeds. They reported much faster completion after reducing batch_count to 20.

Maya (CSM): Great. Actions to close loop:
- Jordan: send the 20m invite for today 3:00 PM PT (include PM)
- Priya: follow up with billing & confirm when payment recovers; advise on permanent quota change
- Maya: open internal ticket with repro, logs, and customer feedback; tag PM + eng
- Luis: prepare commercial uplift doc and renewal risk note

Jordan (Support): Customer asks for: default batch_size controls in dashboard, an onboarding checklist that warns about quota burn, and a trial SLA for ingest reliability. Capturing here for PMs.

Maya (CSM): I'll log those requests into the product board: tags [onboarding][embeddings][trial-sla]. Also marking orbital-331 as "renewal_watch" in CRM until post-sync outcome.

Priya (CS Ops): Billing follow-up: finance confirmed auto-retry scheduled; if payment succeeds we'll propose permanent quota restore. If not, recommend converting to paid trial or reserved pilot.

Luis (AE): I'll notify the renewal owner + champion of the temporary fix and confirm they'll attend the 3pm call.

Jordan (Support): From support POV: resolved — ingest flows are green. Leaving open for CS handoffs and billing resolution.

Maya (CSM): Thanks team. I'll paste the comms I send to the customer and the post-call notes back into this thread after the meeting. :thumbsup:
